requirements.title: Every operation that takes a credential refuses a request without one with 401 and a problem/v1 body
requirements.source: spec 02 §1 (error body, M28), 06 §3; decision record M18

requirements.title: A valid token without the operation's scope is refused with 403 and a problem/v1 body
An unknown identifier is answered 404 with a problem/v1 body where the contract declares 404
A stale If-Match is refused with the 409 or 412 the contract declares, and nothing changes
requirements.source: spec 02 §1 (Retries and conflicts: a 409 is permanent), 02 F1
reasons: the contract gives no valid example body to send with the stale If-Match

requirements.title: An invalid body is refused with the 400 or 422 the contract declares, with a problem/v1 body naming the fields in errors[]
The success case answers a declared 2xx whose body matches the published OpenAPI contract
Published datasets match the contract and are read whole by uspace-core's ED-318 reader
Every vertical limit names an ED-318 reference (AGL, AMSL, WGS84) in m or ft
?at= keeps what applies (and what cannot be evaluated, marked unknown); ?applies_at= annotates every feature; malformed filters are 400
Versions and ETags, If-None-Match 304, signed snapshots, 428 without and 412 on a stale If-Match, a refused publication leaves the version unchanged
A publication appears in /v1/changes as a cis/change/v1 record
A subscriber receives the change as a compact JWS it can verify, within the change-notification target
requirements.source: spec 02 F3, decision record M19; spec 09 §2 (1 s target, national choice)
reasons: the target file names no webhook receiver the CISP can reach (ed318.webhook_listen, webhook_url)

requirements.title: A publisher heartbeat is recorded and the status document applies the stale rule
The public pages the suite loads pass axe at the policy's accessibility bar
reasons: the target file names no public page
